actions: inspected front-door continuous handoff sequencing and integration tests
inspected manager-handoff v3 identity persistence and restart matching
defined front-door and same-vertical restart regression shapes
finding_summary: Generic storage tests already prove a precommit side effect can survive a failed continuous.json replace. The Manager front door lacks the corresponding integration invariant. More importantly, manager-handoff v3 restart identity binds only objective/vertical/domain/generation, while protected routing includes workflow_mode, research target/direction, target venue and stage. Therefore a same-vertical/domain route mutation left by a failed front-door handoff can still match stale identity on a future explicit resume and skip Manager reconciliation. Candidate refined to a disabled handoff-fence plus canonical protected-route fingerprint, retaining existing continuous CAS and process-only resume allowlist.
exact_next_action: Trace failed-handoff objective durability, then design/test a v4 manager-handoff route fingerprint and a same-vertical workflow-mode mismatch resume regression before refining the disabled handoff-fence payload.
